subject.title: feat: play ordered track URI lists

question: Should `spogo play` permanently support variadic ordered track lists across all engines by delegating unsupported native engine operations to Spotify’s Web API?
rationale: The branch introduces a new CLI contract and changes the meaning of engine selection; tests can verify mechanics, but they cannot decide whether cross-engine delegation is the intended product behavior.

options.title: Accept with targeting repair
options.body: Adopt the variadic track-only contract after resolving named device selectors before fallback and adding live Spotify proof.

options.title: Limit to Web API engine
options.body: Expose ordered track lists only where the selected engine natively supports the Web API contract, avoiding implicit engine delegation.

options.title: Decline the overload
options.body: Keep `spogo play` single-resource and leave temporary ordered-list playback outside the current CLI contract.

recommendation.title: Accept with targeting repair
recommendation.body: Adopt the variadic track-only contract after resolving named device selectors before fallback and adding live Spotify proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision affects the repository-wide CLI and engine abstraction originally associated with this repository lineage.
